items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: The first fellow who gave me a chance to play a little was George Lewis. He was playing with René at the time.

ctx.x: I've heard how they did that.
Well, the first fellow, that was very rare. The first fellow who gave me a chance to play a little was George Lewis. He was playing with René at the time.
And he said, go ahead, play, have your fun. I said, okay.
